bareModeHint: Skip on-disk auto-discovery (CLAUDE.md, hooks, plugins, MCP). Faster cold starts; the agent won't see your project's settings.
briefModeHint: Append a concise-output instruction to every send. Useful for chat triage and one-shot questions.
chatMiddlewareHint: Experimental. Let enabled plugins wrap each send via their registered chat middleware. Off by default — no effect unless a plugin provides one.
debugModeHint: Verbose logs from the SDK and any spawned MCP / sub-process. Look for them in the Tauri dev console or the sidecar log file.
defaultSystemPromptPlaceholder: Optional. Prepended to every conversation when a session has no override.
noneYet: None yet. Tools you mark "Allow always" in approval dialogs appear here.
orPasteModelId: Or paste a custom model id
permissionModeHintBefore: Controls how the agent treats tool calls. Most users want
